title: Getting Started
text:
Loading In Data
Here’s the quickest way to load LAMMPS simulation data into VMD:
1topo readlammpsdata DATA_FILE.data
2topo guessatom lammps data
3animate read xtc TRAJECTORY.xtc

1

Read in DATA_FILE.data as a molecule (this includes bonds, angles, dihedrals, and molecule index numbers)!  (topo calls the TopoTools plugin which was written specifically for handling LAMMPS data files. The usual VMD dialog does not have an option for reading that data format in!)

2

guessatom lammps data calls TopoTools to (a) guess each particle type’s element based on its mass; (b) then use each element to set each particle’s name and display radius.  (If you aren’t using regular atom types – for example coarse-grains or virtual sites – you can skip this!)

3

animate will now use the XTC data type to read in the coordinates from your trajectory file TRAJECTORY.xtc.
